_comment: PRODUCTION stage 1 (one-jump pretrain) - single dt-conditioned model over dt in [0.1, 1e3] s.
docs/DECISIONS.md: per-key evidence, and the Inherited / unjustified table for values without it.

precision._comment: amp_mode "true" = Lightning 32-true: no autocast (required for float32 compute); only "mixed" enables autocast. TF32 is allow_tf32 (forced off by runtime.deterministic=true).

_comment_full_dataset: Full-dataset settings: pool_size and output_trajectories_per_file are null (no cap):
every source trajectory of every raw file is used. An integer is a deliberate per-file
subsample (pool_size counts source groups, output_trajectories_per_file written windows),
logged at WARNING and recorded per file in preprocessing_summary.json.
samples_per_source_trajectory=4 draws 4 (dt, t_start) chunks per source trajectory
(draw 0 anchored at the first positive raw time, draws 1-3 log-uniform; dt log-uniform
in every draw) - per-state dt diversity was the main robustness lever in early small-scale tests.

dataset._comment: Epoch by count (docs/DECISIONS.md): 32475 = floor(N_train * 32 / 2048) and 8246528 = N_val * 32 for the 4-file build before the frozen-tail cut (N_train 2078448, N_val 257704), both kept fixed after it (N_train 2070330, N_val 256734: 8246528 of the 256734 x 99 one-step validation windows); 32 windows per trajectory inherited.
